user.title: Connect to htMarquee
user.description: Enter the hostname or IP address of your htMarquee device.

auth_method.title: How should Home Assistant sign in?
auth_method.description: An API token is recommended: you can revoke it on its own, and Home Assistant never stores your admin password. Tokens need htMarquee 1.6.0 or newer with a Premiere license.

api_token.title: API token
api_token.description: In the htMarquee web app open Settings → Integrations → API Tokens, create a token named for example "Home Assistant", and paste it here. It is shown only once.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate htMarquee
reauth_confirm.description: htMarquee at {host} rejected the stored credentials. This normally means the admin password or PIN was changed on the device. Enter the current one to reconnect.

reauth_api_token.title: Reauthenticate htMarquee
reauth_api_token.description: htMarquee at {host} rejected the stored API token. It was probably revoked or has expired. Create a new token in the htMarquee web app (Settings → Integrations → API Tokens) and paste it here.

error.invalid_token: htMarquee did not accept this token. Check it was copied completely and has not been revoked. Tokens need htMarquee 1.6.0 or newer.
error.invalid_token_format: That does not look like an htMarquee API token. A token starts with htm_.

abort.already_configured: This htMarquee device is already configured
